render.command: flife render --run-dir RUN --ticks 3200 --every 2 --width 2160 --height 2160 --no-field --look sphere --color lineage-energy --camera CAMERA --out FRAMES

camera.rule: activity |blur(L[t+1] − L[t−1])| of a whole-world raw preview, blurred to each shot's view; each shot looks where that activity was greatest over the shot, discounting regions already shown

render.meaning: founder lineage lit by energy: the lineage's colour (lineage-energy), lighter as the organism holds more of the energy it needs to divide, black with none, white with 1.8 times it
